briefdescription.para: This function sends the Command Status Wrapper of a mass storage command on bulk IN.

detaileddescription.para: The CSW is built in a dedicated buffer so the received CBW is left intact.

parameterdescription.para: is a pointer to XUsbPs instance of the controller.
is the Command Block Wrapper of the completed command.
is the number of requested bytes not transferred.
is the command status, USB_CSW_CMD_PASSED or USB_CSW_CMD_FAILED.

memberdef.name: ValidateLbaRange

briefdescription.para: This function validates the LBA range of a SCSI READ(10) or WRITE(10) command against the virtual flash.

detaileddescription.para: A command whose range exceeds VFLASH_NUM_BLOCKS is rejected. A command with a zero block count transfers no data, so it is completed here with a good status, or rejected when the host expects a data phase. A command whose CBW data transfer length or direction does not match the block count and the command direction is also rejected, so the data phase never runs out of step with the host.

A rejected command fails with the whole requested data length as residue. When the host expects a data phase, the endpoint of the direction given in the CBW is halted first. The status is then queued on bulk IN, where the controller holds it until the host clears the halt when bulk IN is the stalled endpoint.

parameterdescription.para: is a pointer to XUsbPs instance of the controller.
is the Command Block Wrapper of the command.
is the starting logical block address.
is the number of blocks to transfer.
is the data phase direction, XUSBPS_EP_DIRECTION_IN or XUSBPS_EP_DIRECTION_OUT.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS if the data transfer can proceed.
XST_FAILURE if the command has already been completed.

briefdescription.para: This function validates the length of a bulk OUT buffer received in the data phase of a SCSI WRITE(10) command against the bytes still expected for the command.

detaileddescription.para: A buffer exceeding the remaining length is rejected before it is copied to the virtual flash.
A rejected command fails with the CBW data transfer length less the bytes already copied as residue. Bulk OUT is halted first, and the status is then queued on bulk IN.

parameterdescription.para: is a pointer to XUsbPs instance of the controller.
is the Command Block Wrapper of the command.
is the length of the received data buffer.
is the number of bytes still expected.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS if the buffer can be copied.
XST_FAILURE if the command has already been completed.
